review.intent: Preserve original High quality while reducing redundant CPU work and upload bandwidth
review.method: Inspected exact final phone, iPad-sized and desktop-sized touch stills. Compared matched framebuffer bytes at High; deterministic original scarf-motion trace for vertices/normals and state. No continuous playback or physical-device claim.
review.faultsFixed: Capture harness initially suppressed the fullscreen resize rAF; corrected the harness, confirmed CSS and drawing-buffer sizes and inspected replacement captures. No game UI or quality change was needed.
review.decision: Final static visuals preserve detailed grass, shadows, outlines, colour grade, HUD and touch layout in sampled views. Ready as a focused performance draft, subject to exact-head CI and physical-device performance limits.
